publicReleaseNotes: Lamp 1.5.0 adds confirmed component changes on live incidents with catch-up email, extensions to maintenance in progress, provider acceptance on Deliveries and in CSV, complete sender-domain checks and rer signin. Aligned DKIM with DMARC is sufficient under NOTIFY-010. Migration 0023 adds one-use owner sign-in grants and 0024 adds Base import-kit custody tables. The checkout uses rer 0.2.22. Local mail is suppressed; the development mail viewer and rer outbox are removed. Hosted APIs and existing data remain compatible.

NOTIFY-010.summary: Setup and deployment accept aligned DKIM with DMARC without requiring SPF on the From domain; notification threading and list headers remain required.
NOTIFY-010.was: Mail headers: Every notification email carries `List-Id`, `List-Archive`, and `List-Help` identifying the page, `Auto-Submitted: auto-generated` so it triggers no vacation reply, and, for every update after an incident's first, `In-Reply-To` and `References` naming the message that carried the first, so a mail client groups an incident's updates into one thread. `pnpm setup` fails naming the record when the From address's domain publishes no SPF, no DKIM key for the configured selector, or no DMARC policy.
NOTIFY-010.now: Mail headers: Every notification email carries `List-Id`, `List-Archive`, and `List-Help` identifying the page, `Auto-Submitted: auto-generated` so it triggers no vacation reply, and, for every update after an incident's first, `In-Reply-To` and `References` naming the message that carried the first, so a mail client groups an incident's updates into one thread. `pnpm setup` and `rer deploy` fail naming the record when the From address's domain has no reachable DKIM public key for the configured selector or no DMARC policy. Aligned DKIM is sufficient; SPF at the From domain itself is not required, because a provider may authenticate its separate return-path domain.

proseChanges.summary: Local development silently suppresses mail and no longer provides captured messages or rer outbox.
proseChanges.was: Local development retained messages in a mail viewer and offered rer outbox for sign-in and subscriber links.
proseChanges.now: Local mail is neither sent nor retained. Use automatic one-click owner entry locally and a hosted installation to check actual mail delivery. The old diagnostic address only explains suppression.
proseChanges.ownerAction: Remove obsolete local outbox storage after backing up application data, as described in the 1.5.0 upgrade notes.

proseChanges.summary: Owners must monitor the configured From mailbox and remove subscribers who request unsubscribe by email.
proseChanges.now: Use a monitored From mailbox. Process mailto unsubscribe requests in Subscribers by removing the matching destination; HTTPS one-click unsubscribe remains automatic.

extensionPointChanges.summary: SentMail.disposition replaces the development-only captured result with suppressed. Provider acceptance is unchanged; custom adapters that handled captured must handle suppressed. Local suppression retains no messages.

migrations.buyerSteps: Apply after 0022 before starting this revision. It adds Base's one-use owner sign-in grant table for rer signin; existing operator identities, sessions and migration history are unchanged. Grants are installation-local and do not travel in exports.

Apply after 0023 before starting this revision. It adds Base import-kit's additive custody tables and triggers (reversal fences, preparation steps, person-erasure retirements and journal, erasure progress) that the refreshed import kit uses; existing import history, custody and migration history are unchanged.

agentUpdateInstructions: Back up data and owner source. Apply 0023_owner_signin.sql after 0022_import_maintenance_updates.sql, then 0024_import_kit_custody_upgrade.sql, before starting 1.5.0. Migration 0024 adds Base import-kit custody tables and triggers; local portability excludes this installation-specific import custody. Preserve operator identities, sessions, published records, migration history and installation identities. The migration adds only installation-local, one-use owner sign-in grants excluded from exports. Run rer verify separately and pnpm run verify:release from v1.4.0 before adopting. Update custom local mail adapters from captured to suppressed; local mail capture and rer outbox have been removed. Monitor the configured From mailbox and action email unsubscribe requests in Subscribers. Review the 1.5.0 local outbox cleanup instructions; retain the application database and snapshots. Hosted APIs and existing data remain compatible.
